name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Two fixes/additions. (1) Fix: the Browse tab came back completely empty for a Plex source whose libraries aren't (yet) in its sync allow-list - the normal starting state for a freshly-connected Plex server, since nothing is allowed for auto-sync until the admin opts a library in on the Libraries tab. Browse wrongly reused the same sync-consent check GetItemsAsync applies for scheduled syncing; it now calls a new, unfiltered GetAllItemsAsync instead, since ad-hoc browsing/downloading one item was never supposed to require sync consent. (2) Prefer-higher-quality review list: each suggested title now has a 'Never ask about this one' link that permanently excludes just that title from future suggestions, plus a 'Manage exceptions' list under the Advanced setting to review or undo exclusions - a per-title override to the global prefer-higher-quality toggle. 329 tests, all green.
